title: Cross-team engineering leadership — weekly staff notes (2026-06-08)
body:
Attendees: Aisha (chair), Ben C., María, Samantha, Devon, Rishi (SRE), Claire (Platform), Jin (Applied ML)

Agenda: weekly updates from subteams, blockers, incident follow-ups, Dedicated capacity rollout status, quantization kernel regressions, on-call rotation reminders, action items.

Quick notes / tl;dr:
- Serving runtime: small perf regression on long-context streaming p50 (INF-4512) - suspected kernel selection path with CUDA 12 upgrade. Patch in review (PR #812), perf test running on staging.
- Platform: Dedicated capacity onboarding for customer X next week; still waiting on quota bump from cloud (ticket PLT-3987). Blocker for guaranteed throughput tests.
- Observability: new trace sampling config rolled to staging; cost/trace trade-offs looked reasonable. ETA for prod flip: 2026-06-15 pending final sign-off.
- SRE/incidents: two infra incidents in last 7 days; RCA done for the larger outage (root cause: autoscaler thrash when burst policy triggered + cloud API rate limits). Proposed mitigation already in canary.

Detailed updates:

1) Serving-runtime (Ben C.)
- Status: focused on long-context generation perf. We identified a regression after a dependency bump (attention-kernel v2.1). Regression is deterministic in our microbench harness for sequences > 8k.
- Action: reverted the kernel selection logic to previous heuristic in canary; pending larger patch to add heuristic fallback when sequence distribution is skewed. PR #812 opened (code + perf benchmark).
- Risk: if kernel fallback not in time, customers using long-session chat (enterprise) may see 10-15% p50 increases. Mitigation: enable preferential routing to fallback variant for affected customers.
- Blockers: hardware repro of the regression on A100-80GB - infra queue delay ~24h. Need capacity priority for validation.

2) Platform & Dedicated (Claire)
- Customer X Dedicated onboarding scheduled for 2026-06-15. Remaining items: quota bump (PLT-3987), SSO cert rotate (customer side), legal sign-off (contract addendum).
- Autoscaler policy: new burst policy landed but needs load-testing; will use Dedicated canary cluster next Wed.
- Ask: Platform needs an SLO for turn-up time for Dedicated customers documented in Console - product to own wording.

3) Observability (María)
- Trace sampling reconfiguration deployed to staging. P95 trace ingest cost cut ~28% in staging while retaining top-10 traces for each route.
- Metric dashboards: added token-cost by model and by route; early feedback from FinOps is that the granularity is useful.
- Next: plan to enable trace sampling in prod with gradual ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over two weeks.

4) Site Reliability / Incidents (Rishi)
- Incident summary: two incidents last week: (a) autoscaler thrash causing pod churn for small clusters; (b) transient cloud API rate-limit for spot GPU provisioning.
- RCA: autoscaler thrash triggered by burst policy + rapid successive scale-down events. Fix: add minimal stabilization window (30s) and exponential backoff for scale-down. Canary in staging now.
- Action items: add a dashboard for autoscaler scale events per cluster; alert if >5 events in 10m. Owner: Rishi.

5) Applied ML / Model ops (Jin)
- Eval run: Model-quant v0.9 shows ~2% generation quality delta on internal eval set vs baseline, but ~38% token-cost reduction with 4-bit quantization on A100. Need to validate customer-facing prompts.
- Concern: some edge-case structured output formatting regressions; working with serving-runtime to add post-generation format-checker in the pipeline for canaries.

Decisions / Notes:
- We will proceed with staged rollout of the trace sampling configuration to prod starting 2026-06-15 unless an issue is flagged. (Decision: María + Rishi)
- For the long-context kernel regression, do controlled rollback in prod routing for impacted model variants if PR #812 doesn't land by EOD Tuesday. (Decision: Ben + Aisha)

Open questions / unresolved:
- How quickly can infra provide A100 validation capacity? Dev/infra to estimate timeline. (Claire + Ben)
- Product question: finalize Dedicated turn-up SLO wording - product to propose by next meeting.
- Is on-call escalation doc up to date for Dedicated customer issues? Owner: SRE to review.

Action items (owner, due):
- Ben: finish perf patch + merge PR #812, run full microbench on A100 canary (due 2026-06-09).
- Claire: follow up with cloud partner on quota bump PLT-3987 and get ETA (due 2026-06-10).
- Rishi: add autoscaler scale-event dashboard + alert, and monitor canary for 72h (due 2026-06-11).
- María: prepare rollout plan for trace sampling (ramp schedule + rollback criteria) and post to Confluence (due 2026-06-12).
- Jin: run focused evals for quant v0.9 on customer prompt corpus and report regressions (due 2026-06-11).
- Aisha: follow up with Legal for contract addendum for Customer X (due 2026-06-12).

Misc / notes to self:
- Reminder: leadership offsite 2026-07-07; items to prep: 1) infra capacity roadmap, 2) cost optimization OKRs, 3) Dedicated go-to-market checklist.
- Keep an eye on any new bug reports in INF-4512 watchers - escalate to on-call if customer-facing reports increase.

Next meeting: 2026-06-15 10:00 PDT

References / links: JIRA-INF-4512 (long-context perf), JIRA-PLT-3987 (quota bump), PR #812 (serving-runtime kernel fallback), Confluence: Batching-Performance-Playbook

Status: rough working notes - will tidy after reviewers add comments.
